text:
lina-partnerships: Quick heads-up — PartnerX is moving forward with an adapter overhaul that changes our SDK init fields. They're proposing a cutover in mid-May, need to align stability window + joint announce timing.

matt-infra: Do we know if this is a rename-only change or payload reshape? impact on runtime?

sana-sdks: From the partner note: it's a rename of `client_id` -> `integration_id` for the new auth flow, plus a small optional `region` string. No change to token exchange.

joe-partner-rep: Confirmed. PartnerX wants 2026-05-12 as their GA date but can shift if we need a legal/marketplace window. They also want a joint blog week-of 2026-05-19.

lina-partnerships: Proposed plan: 1) SDK transitional shim accepting both fields + deprecation warning, 2) a 60–90 day stability window where both names work, 3) marketplace listing update + joint comms slot after legal okay. Sounds good?

matt-infra: Ops note: if we ship a shim, add a feature-flagged telemetry key so we can roll back if we see errors. Also will want to reserve a deploy window to avoid release clashes.

sana-sdks: I'll prototype the shim. Quick example we can push to partner branch:

```
// transitional parsing
const integrationId = opts.integration_id || opts.client_id;
if (!integrationId) throw new Error('integration_id or client_id required');
if (opts.client_id && opts.integration_id) console.warn('both client_id and integration_id provided');
// emit deprecation metric: `sdk.deprecation.client_id` with boolean
```

eric-legal: Need to review the partner contract for name/branding clauses and the joint press wording. Please route any proposed PR quotes to legal by 2026-05-01.

joe-partner-rep: @lina-partnerships we'll ask PartnerX to hold their press until legal clears. They said +1 week is acceptable if necessary.

marketplace-bot: Automated notice: Marketplace listing freeze window 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-25. Submit listing changes by 2026-05-07 to avoid rollback.

lina-partnerships: Action items: Sana -> SDK shim + deprecation warning (PR by 2026-04-30), Matt -> feature flag + telemetry tag `vendorx_adapter_migration`, Eric -> legal review by 2026-05-01, Joe -> confirm partner announce flexibility. Add :thumbsup: reactions when you ack.

sana-sdks: Will do. I'll also draft a 1-pager migration guide + code examples for the partner portal. ETA 2026-05-03.

matt-infra: Added telemetry event name: `adapter.vendorx.migration.v1`. I'll add the flag and a canary rollout plan; we'll monitor error-rate and latency delta.

lina-partnerships: Do we want a hard-cut deprecation timeline published? Suggested: 90 days graceful period, then server-side enforcement and deprecation header in responses.

eric-legal: 90 days is reasonable from a compliance perspective if partner agrees. I'll confirm language for the deprecation notice.

joe-partner-rep: PartnerX OK with 90-day grace if the joint comms are synchronized. They prefer the joint blog after their internal PR.

lina-partnerships: I'll schedule a 15-min sync Tue 2026-04-28 10:00 PT to lock timelines and owners. Invite incoming.

matt-infra: Quick checklist request: add a tiny AB test to quantify how many clients still send `client_id` after GA so we can measure migration progress.

sana-sdks: Good call — will emit `sdk.migration.client_id_present` metric in the shim.

lina-partnerships: Thanks all. Thread closed unless blockers.

eric-legal: Acked :eyes:

joe-partner-rep: Thanks — will push partner to confirm slot and hold press if needed :white_check_mark:
